name: Social Login (Naver/Kakao/Google/Apple/Facebook/X/LINE/Microsoft/GitHub)
description: Adds Naver, Kakao, Google, Apple, Facebook, X, LINE, Microsoft and GitHub login/signup.

settings.page_description: Turn each provider on and enter the keys issued in its developer console.
settings.notice: Register the Callback URL (Redirect URI) shown in each provider's section in that provider's developer console. Only providers that are turned on appear on the login page, and a provider can only be turned on once all of its key fields are filled in. If the login page doesn't update after saving, clear the cache.
settings.guide_item_1: Enabled providers appear on the login page in this order: Naver, Kakao, Google, Apple, Facebook, X, LINE, Microsoft, GitHub. The first 3 are on the first row; the rest are on a second row that opens with "More sign-in options".
settings.guide_item_2: Callback URLs are based on the site address (APP_URL). The scheme (http/https) and www must match the address visitors actually use.
settings.guide_item_3: Auto-linking: a social account is linked to an existing member with the same email only when the provider vouches that the email is verified (Kakao, Google, Naver, Apple, X, GitHub). Facebook, LINE and Microsoft sign-ins create a new account; existing members can link them from their profile page.
settings.callback_label: Callback URL (Redirect URI) — register in the console

naver_enabled.label: Enable Naver login
naver_enabled.hint: When on, the Naver button appears on the login page and in the profile link list. All fields below are required to turn it on.

naver_client_id.label: Naver Client ID
naver_client_id.hint: Client ID of your Naver Developers application.

naver_client_secret.label: Naver Client Secret
naver_client_secret.hint: Client Secret of your Naver Developers application.

kakao_enabled.label: Enable Kakao login
kakao_enabled.hint: When on, the Kakao button appears on the login page and in the profile link list. All fields below are required to turn it on.

kakao_client_id.label: Kakao REST API key
kakao_client_id.hint: The REST API key (app key) from the Kakao Developers console.

kakao_client_secret.label: Kakao Client Secret
kakao_client_secret.hint: Client Secret issued under Kakao Login > Security.

google_enabled.label: Enable Google login
google_enabled.hint: When on, the Google button appears on the login page and in the profile link list. All fields below are required to turn it on.

google_client_id.label: Google client ID
google_client_id.hint: OAuth client ID issued in Google Cloud Console.

google_client_secret.label: Google client secret
google_client_secret.hint: OAuth client secret issued in Google Cloud Console.

apple_enabled.label: Enable Apple login
apple_enabled.hint: When on, the Apple button appears on the login page and in the profile link list. All fields below are required to turn it on.

apple_client_id.label: Services ID (client_id)
apple_client_id.hint: The identifier you created under Identifiers > Services IDs (e.g. com.example.web). Not the App ID.

apple_team_id.label: Team ID
apple_team_id.hint: Your 10-character Apple Developer Team ID (Membership page).

apple_key_id.label: Key ID
apple_key_id.hint: 10-character Key ID of the key created under Keys with "Sign in with Apple" enabled.

apple_private_key.label: Private key (.p8 contents)
apple_private_key.hint: Open the downloaded AuthKey_XXXXXXXXXX.p8 as text and paste everything from -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY----- to the end. It is used to sign the client_secret JWT automatically.

facebook_enabled.label: Enable Facebook login
facebook_enabled.hint: When on, the Facebook button appears on the login page and in the profile link list. All fields below are required to turn it on.

facebook_client_id.label: Facebook App ID
facebook_client_id.hint: App ID from Meta for Developers > App settings > Basic.

facebook_client_secret.label: Facebook App Secret
facebook_client_secret.hint: App Secret on the same page.

x_enabled.label: Enable X login
x_enabled.hint: When on, the X button appears on the login page and in the profile link list. All fields below are required to turn it on.

x_client_id.label: X OAuth 2.0 Client ID
x_client_id.hint: X Developer Portal > App > Keys and tokens > OAuth 2.0 Client ID (not the API Key).

x_client_secret.label: X OAuth 2.0 Client Secret
x_client_secret.hint: OAuth 2.0 Client Secret on the same page. Set the app type to "Web App (Confidential client)".

line_enabled.label: Enable LINE login
line_enabled.hint: When on, the LINE button appears on the login page and in the profile link list. All fields below are required to turn it on.

line_client_id.label: LINE Channel ID
line_client_id.hint: Channel ID from LINE Developers console > LINE Login channel > Basic settings.

line_client_secret.label: LINE Channel secret
line_client_secret.hint: Channel secret on the same page.

microsoft_enabled.label: Enable Microsoft login
microsoft_enabled.hint: When on, the Microsoft button appears on the login page and in the profile link list. All fields below are required to turn it on.

microsoft_client_id.label: Application (client) ID
microsoft_client_id.hint: Application (client) ID from Microsoft Entra admin center > App registrations > Overview.

microsoft_client_secret.label: Client secret value
microsoft_client_secret.hint: The "Value" created under Certificates & secrets > New client secret (not the Secret ID). Replace it before it expires.

github_enabled.label: Enable GitHub login
github_enabled.hint: When on, the GitHub button appears on the login page and in the profile link list. All fields below are required to turn it on.

github_client_id.label: GitHub Client ID
github_client_id.hint: Client ID from GitHub > Settings > Developer settings > OAuth Apps.

github_client_secret.label: GitHub Client Secret
github_client_secret.hint: Client secret generated on the same page.

login.heading: Quick sign-in with social accounts
login.too_many_attempts: Too many sign-in requests. Please try again in a moment.

profile.unlink_blocked_no_password: You have no password set and no other linked account, so this can't be unlinked. Set a password first.

auto_linked.name: Social account auto-linked
auto_linked.description: Sent when a social login is auto-linked to an existing account
auto_linked.subject: [{app_name}] Your {provider_name} account was automatically linked
auto_linked.body:
Hi {name},

A {provider_name} account ({provider_email}) was automatically linked to your {app_name} account. If this wasn't you, change your password immediately and unlink it from your profile page.
